==Description==
'''Frankenstein''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Nightmare Carnival]] as part of the [[Halloween 2019 Event]]. '''Frankenstein''' had quite high health and an average walkspeed, making it quite hard to kill. It appeared behind other enemies, making it even harder to kill.

'''Frankenstein''' could also be spawned by the [[Jack O' Bot]].

==Appearance==
'''Frankenstein''' represented the common depiction of Frankenstein's monster; giant, greenish-pale skin and two bolts on the head showing that the monster was animated with electricity. It wore a black cloak, had a black torso and legs, and had black straight hair. It had a concerned straight face.

==Strategy==
*Use high DPS towers to deal with '''Frankensteins''', such as [[Ranger|Outlaw]] or [[Minigunner]].
**The [[Militant|John]] and [[Commander]] can be used to increase the DPS of these towers.
*The [[Rocketeer]] can be used, but '''Frankensteins''' come out in pretty spread out groups, meaning that the explosion will be less effective.
**They can, however, be used to tackle the enemies in front of '''Frankenstein'''.

==Trivia==
*Contrary to common belief, '''Frankenstein''' is the erroneous term to call the monster. As stated in the origin 1818 novel ''Frankenstein'', the monster is actually called Frankenstein's monster or the Creature, while Frankenstein is the creator of the monster.
**This enemy may be purposely called '''Frankenstein''' as a reference to the common misconception.
